about_the_game:
A SLG strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era!

The only way to play with a famous general is that there can only be one famous general in a single district!

Players need to capture famous generals by conquering cities and seizing territories, and once they persuade these generals to surrender, they can be put to their own use!

Players need to upgrade their technology level, construct buildings in their fiefdom, and build structures such as farmland, barracks, and academies, in order to increase their population and recruit more soldiers to enhance their strength!

By conquering bandits and seizing cities, players can level up their generals. The higher the level, the better the stats. Additionally, various equipment can further enhance the generals' stats!

After gaining sufficient strength, you can embark on a global conquest, seizing cities of other nations and making achievements, ultimately unifying the entire world!
